method_limits: Independent raw GLB decoder plus read-only original/final Blender source reopen. Separate full-surface plane/interval/barycentric intersection logic did not use the maker VTK broad-phase predicate. Coplanar positive-area clipping includes adjacent triangle pairs.

Numerical strict-intersection thresholds: plane tolerance about 1e-11 m, intersection length greater than 1e-9 m, interior barycentrics greater than 1e-7; coplanar positive area greater than 1e-13 square metres. Intentional vertex/edge touches and coincident adjacent-bed contacts are not treated as self-intersections.
